0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, fourth in the East and 1.5 games back in third place in the Atlantic) are on the road against the Los Angeles Lakers (4-1, first in the Pacific and third in the West), with Toronto coming off a loss and Los Angeles on a win streak. Toronto will be without Kawhi Leonard, who is out with knee inflammation and is averaging 19.5 points and 25.8 minutes per game this season, and Nate Bittle, who is out with a foot fracture, while the Lakers will be missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Raptors lost both games against the Lakers in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 110-93 defeat in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
